title: The review runs tests.py only after the fresh-context reviewer has returned, so its load does not push the suite over the ceiling
goal: Review step 4 and the review story's checks order the whole tests.py run after the reviewer subagent or headless session returns (it loads the host), since a concurrent run took 21 s against the 20 s darwin ceiling and failed while the same suite took 19.1 s on an idle host (SP-rvslem3h).
